summary: Reputation reinstatement is hold with 2 critical, 7 high, and 4 warning finding(s).

findings.message: researcher-beta is still inside the minimum probation window.
findings.impact: Reputation accrual and badge/leaderboard re-entry should remain paused until the cooling-off period ends.

findings.message: researcher-beta received 2 reputation delta(s) during probation.
findings.impact: Probation should pause reputation accrual, badges, and leaderboard effects.
findings.remediation: Reverse or quarantine probation-window reputation deltas before reinstatement.

findings.message: researcher-beta has an unresolved appeal tied to the probation record.
findings.impact: Profiles should not receive reputation deltas while the moderation outcome is still contested.
findings.remediation: Resolve the appeal or keep reputation accrual paused.

findings.message: researcher-gamma has an incomplete probation record.
findings.impact: Probation holds should explain the moderation basis and start time.
findings.remediation: Attach reason code, start timestamp, and moderation receipt.

findings.message: researcher-gamma has no reinstatement request timestamp.
findings.impact: The system cannot prove that a contributor asked to re-enter reputation accrual.
findings.remediation: Record a reinstatement request and reviewer packet.

findings.message: researcher-beta lacks the required reinstatement reviewer quorum.
findings.impact: Single-reviewer reinstatement can undermine moderation consistency.
findings.remediation: Add independent moderator approvals before re-entry.

findings.message: researcher-gamma lacks the required reinstatement reviewer quorum.
findings.impact: Single-reviewer reinstatement can undermine moderation consistency.
findings.remediation: Add independent moderator approvals before re-entry.

findings.message: researcher-beta has not completed required remediation action(s): updated-profile-attestation.
findings.impact: Reinstatement should require verifiable remediation before reputation signals resume.
findings.remediation: Complete and attach evidence for all required remediation actions.

findings.message: researcher-gamma has not completed required remediation action(s): moderation-acknowledgement, updated-profile-attestation.
findings.impact: Reinstatement should require verifiable remediation before reputation signals resume.
findings.remediation: Complete and attach evidence for all required remediation actions.

findings.message: researcher-beta re-entry score cap is above policy.
findings.impact: Gradual re-entry protects leaderboards and badges from immediate trust jumps.
findings.remediation: Apply the policy score cap until the post-reinstatement review window closes.

findings.message: researcher-gamma re-entry score cap is above policy.
findings.impact: Gradual re-entry protects leaderboards and badges from immediate trust jumps.
findings.remediation: Apply the policy score cap until the post-reinstatement review window closes.

findings.message: researcher-beta reinstatement summary is not configured for public-redacted visibility.
findings.impact: Community timelines need transparency without exposing private moderation notes.
findings.remediation: Publish a redacted reinstatement receipt and keep private evidence internal.
